# Meera's Phone

Meera's family gets a basic phone. A year later Meera wants a smartphone. Soon after, she wants one with a bigger screen and a better camera.

**Predict:** When does this wanting stop?

options.text: It stops once she has a good phone. People who have enough stop wanting.
It stops when she sees fewer advertisements.
It never fully stops. Each want that is met makes room for a new one.
